Filter_A.name: Filter_A_NoUptrend
Filter_A.description: When trend_regime == UPTREND, prohibit opening NEW long positions. Existing positions held until normal exit.

Filter_B.name: Filter_B_DownsizeVolExp
Filter_B.description: When vol_dynamic == VOL_EXPANDING, multiply target weight by 0.5 (30% -> 15%). Normal rules otherwise.

Filter_C.name: Filter_C_NoVolExp
Filter_C.description: When vol_dynamic == VOL_EXPANDING, prohibit opening NEW long positions. VOL_CONTRACTING trades normally.
